senses.gloss:
शैशव शैशव, अम्, n. (fr. शिशु), childhood,
infancy, pupilage, the period under age (i. e. under
sixteen); N. of a portion of the Sāma-veda.

शैशुनाग, आस्, m. pl. (fr. शिशु-नाग), N. of a
dynasty founded by Śiśu-nāga.

शैशिर शैशिर, अस्, ई, अम्, belonging to the
Śiśira or dewy season; composed by Śaiśira; (अस्),
m., N. of a mountain; of a founder of a supposed
separate Śākhā of the Ṛg-veda; of a dark kind of
Caṭaka bird.
—शैशिर-शाखा, f., N. of a Śākhā of
the Ṛg-veda (perhaps only a subdivision of the
Śākala).

शैशिरि, इस्, m., N. of a teacher of the White
Yajur-veda.

शैशिरीय, N. of one of the seven Śākala texts.
—शैशिरीय-शाखा, f. a subordinate branch of the
Śākala-śākhā.

शैशिरेय, अस्, m., N. of a teacher of the Ṛg-
veda.

शैषिक शैषिक, अस्, ई, अम्, relating to a re-
mainder, belonging to the end or termination.

शैष्योपाध्यायिका शैष्योपाध्यायिका, f. (fr.
शिष्य + उपाध्याय), instruction of youth, tuition.

सैसक सैसक, अस्, ई, अम्, (fr. सीस), leaden, of
lead.
